n2ddac2e55a7.s: The basic components of a temple in the conventional arrangement are:
o: Garbhagriha, mandapa, gopuram and prakara wall only
Garbhagriha, mandapa, shikhara or vimana, and an axial vahana with dhvaja pillar
Garbhagriha, shikhara, kalyana mandapa and temple tank only
Mandapa, vimana, gopuram and prakara wall only
n2ddac2e55a7.x: The basic components are the garbhagriha, mandapa, northern shikhara or southern vimana, and the vahana and dhvaja pillar placed axially before the sanctum.

nf8850b862c5.s: The Kakatiya 'sandbox technology' used in temples such as Ramappa refers to:
o: Hollow sand-filled pillars that lightened the vimana
Sand-cast bronze images placed in the garbhagriha
Foundation pits filled with sand, stone chips and earth that cushioned the temple against earthquakes
A sand moat dug around the temple for defence
nf8850b862c5.x: Kakatiya builders filled foundation pits with sand, stone chips and earth to cushion temples on black cotton soil, which is why Ramappa survived earthquakes.

n2619506f646.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with its region?
n2619506f646.x: Kondavidu is associated with the Guntur region, not East Godavari. Addanki is in Prakasam and Kondapalli in Krishna.

nap-history-21-19.s: Which of the following works was NOT written by Bammera Potana?
nap-history-21-19.x: Sahitya Chintamani was written by Pedakomati Vema Reddy; Potana wrote Narayana Satakam, Andhra Bhagavatam and Bhogini Dandakam.

n2ccc3ee6ea4.s: Kondavidu passed to Vijayanagara in 1424 during the reign of:
n2ccc3ee6ea4.x: After the death of Racha Vema Reddi, Kondavidu passed to Vijayanagara under Deva Raya II in 1424.

n0df5bd3ad12.s: Which of the following pairs of Reddi village functionaries is correctly matched?
n0df5bd3ad12.x: The Karnam was the accountant, the Reddi or Peddakapu the headman and the Talari the watchman.

nba4d1ba00e7.s: The Sarpavaram inscription records the marriage of Kataya Vema's son to Vijayalakshmi, daughter of:
nba4d1ba00e7.x: The Sarpavaram inscription refers to a treaty in which Harihara II gave his daughter Vijayalakshmi in marriage to Kataya Vema's son.

nap-history-35-14.s: Who occupied the Reddi throne after Anavema Reddy?
nap-history-35-14.x: In the Kondaveedu line Prolaya Vema was followed by Anavema, and Anavema by Kumaragiri Reddy.

nap-history-36-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-36-13.x: Srinatha wrote Srungara Naishadham. Sangeeta Chintamani is by Pedakomati Vema Reddy, Vasantarajeeyam by Kumaragiri Reddy and Gatha Saptasati was compiled by Hala.

nap-history-5-18.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-5-18.x: Vinnakota Peddana wrote Kavyalankara Chudamani. Padma Puranam is by Madiki Singana, Vishnupuranam by Vennalakanti Suranna and Andhra Sabda Chintamani by Nannaya.

nap-history-44-9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Pedakomati Vema Reddy – Karpura Vasanta Rayalu
nap-history-44-9.x: Recharla Rudra was called Kakatiya Rajya Sthapanacharya; Kumaragiri was Karpura Vasanta Rayalu, Pedakomati Vema Sarvagna and Konda Venkatappaiah Desha Bhakta.

nap-history-31-11.s: Which of the following pairs of dynasty/janapada and capital is correctly matched?
nap-history-31-11.x: The Kakatiyas first ruled from Anamakonda; Assaka's capital was Bodhan, Anupa's Mahishmathi and the Brihatpalayanas' Koduru.

nap-history-31-5.s: Which of the following dynasty–capital pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-31-5.x: The Musunuri Nayaks ruled from Rekapalli; the Satavahanas ruled from Paithan, the Ikshvakus from Vijayapuri and the Salankayanas from Vengipuram.

n7a11753340e.s: Which work was composed by Sarvagna Singa Bhupala of Rachakonda?
n7a11753340e.x: Sarvagna Singa Bhupala, a Sanskrit scholar-king, composed Rasarnava Sudhakara, a work on dramaturgy.

n14ef9e443d2.s: Which of the following work–subject pairs is correctly matched?
o: Sangeeta Sudhakaram — Sanskrit dramaturgy and poetics
Rasarnava Sudhakaram — commentary on Sangita Ratnakara
Rasarnava Sudhakaram — Sanskrit dramaturgy and poetics
Sangeeta Chintamani — Sanskrit dramaturgy and poetics
n14ef9e443d2.x: Rasarnava Sudhakaram deals with Sanskrit dramaturgy and poetics; Sangeeta Sudhakaram is a music work commenting on Sarngadeva's Sangita Ratnakara.

nap-history-31-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Paithan was the capital of the Satavahanas.
Vengipuram was the capital of the Salankayanas.
Vijayapuri was the capital of the Ikshvakus.
Anamakonda was the only capital of the Kakatiyas.
nap-history-31-2.x: Anamakonda (Hanamakonda) was only the first Kakatiya capital; the capital later moved to Warangal (Orugallu).

n6ff19df8ab3.s: Under the Poligar system, which landed families became zamindars?
n6ff19df8ab3.x: Under the Poligar system, Velama, Reddi and Raju landed families became zamindars.

n2b644801b14.s: Which of the following source–information pairs is correctly matched?
o: Anantavaram inscription – Vijayanagara help to the Reddis
Draksharama inscription – Krishnadevaraya's triumph over the Gajapatis
Penugonda inscription – Kapileswara's attack on Tiran Andhra in 1448
Victory pillars at Simhachalam and Potnuru – Defeat of the Virupaksharayas
n2b644801b14.x: The Penugonda inscription records Kapileswara's attack on Tiran Andhra in 1448. Anantavaram records the Virupaksharayas' defeat, Draksharama Vijayanagara help to the Reddis, and the victory pillars Krishnadevaraya's triumph.

n967e2a195bb.s: Which of the following poet–title pairs is correctly matched?
n967e2a195bb.x: Nannaya is Adikavi; Tikkana is Kavibrahma and Errana is Prabandha Parameswara.

n1cbbf47ed91.s: Which of the following title–holder pairs is correctly matched?
n1cbbf47ed91.x: Errana was Sambhudasa. Kavibrahma was Tikkana, Andhra Kavita Pitamaha Allasani Peddana and Kavisarvabhauma Srinatha.

n504af18d6dd.s: Which of the following work–author pairs is correctly matched?
n504af18d6dd.x: Appakaviyam is by Kakunuri Appakavi. Andhra Shabda Chintamani is ascribed to Nannaya, Kavi Vakbandham to Tikkana and Kavyalankara Chudamani to Vinnakota Peddana.

na93bf3fd20c.s: Which of the following work–literary form pairs is correctly matched?
na93bf3fd20c.x: Nrusimha Puranam is a Kshetra-mahatmya kavya. Dasakumara Charitra is a story kavya, Markandeya Puranam a Purana and Raghavapandaviyam a dvyarthi kavya.

n331db93d215.s: Which of the following Kakatiya-court author–work pairs is correctly matched?
n331db93d215.x: Jayapa Senani wrote Nritta Ratnavali (with Geeta and Vadya Ratnavali); Vidyanatha wrote Prataparudra Yashobhushanam.

na504bcee665.s: Who founded the Delhi Sultanate in 1206 after the death of Muhammad Ghori?
na504bcee665.x: Qutbuddin Aibak, Ghori's slave and Master of Stables, founded the Delhi Sultanate in 1206.

nindian-history-21-12.s: Regarding Muhammad Ghori's Gujarat campaign, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Mount Abu – Queen mother who acted as regent
Mularaja II – Area near which the battle of Kasahrada was fought
nindian-history-21-12.x: Ghori's Gujarat campaign came in 1178, when Mularaja II, with his mother Naika Devi as regent, defeated him at Kasahrada near Mount Abu.

naa9c0f7e317.s: Muhammad Ghori entered India through which pass?
naa9c0f7e317.x: Muhammad Ghori entered India through the Gomal Pass.

nindian-history-10-6.s: Which of the following dynasty–capital pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-10-6.x: The Solankis ruled from Anhilwada; the Gurjara-Pratiharas from Kannauj, the Paramaras from Dhara and the Kalachuris from Tripuri.

n8136f462a19.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Kumbhalgarh fort was built by Rana Kumbha.
2. The Kirti Stambha at Chittor was built by the Jain merchant Jijaji in the 12th century.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n8136f462a19.x: Both are correct: Rana Kumbha built Kumbhalgarh, and the Kirti Stambha was built by the Jain merchant Jijaji.

n5c714b82d65.s: Which of the following source–author pairs is correctly matched?
n5c714b82d65.x: Futuh-us-Salatin was written by Isami; Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi is by Ziauddin Barani and Khazain-ul-Futuh by Amir Khusrau.

ndaf78414fe5.s: Which of the following Deccan campaign–ruler/outcome pairs is correctly matched?
ndaf78414fe5.x: Devagiri was ruled by Ramachandra. Warangal was under Prataparudra II, Dwarasamudra under Vira Ballala III, and the Pandya kingdom of Madurai was sacked.

nindian-history-10-17.s: Who shifted the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad and then back to Delhi?
nindian-history-10-17.x: Muhammad bin Tughlaq moved the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad (Devagiri) in 1327 and later back to Delhi.

n4a6c50dafb5.s: Which of the following Firoz Shah Tughlaq institution–function pairs is correctly matched?
o: Diwan-i-Istihqaq – Pensions and grants to deserving persons
n4a6c50dafb5.x: Diwan-i-Istihqaq gave pensions and grants; Diwan-i-Khairat handled charity, Diwan-i-Bandagan slaves, and Dar-ul-Shifa was a free hospital.

nindian-history-97-6.s: Which of the following Sultan–policy pairs is correctly matched?
o: Firoz Shah Tughlaq – Canals, irrigation and public works
Alauddin Khalji – Token currency and capital transfer
Muhammad bin Tughlaq – Blood and Iron policy
nindian-history-97-6.x: Firoz Shah Tughlaq built canals and public works; Alauddin brought market control, Balban Blood and Iron, and Muhammad bin Tughlaq token currency and the capital transfer.

nindian-history-17-23.s: Regarding the First Battle of Panipat, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Handlers of Babur's artillery – Daulat Khan and Alam Khan
nindian-history-17-23.x: First Panipat was fought in 1526 against Ibrahim Lodi; artillery was decisive and was handled by Ustad Ali Quli and Mustafa.

nindian-history-4-12.s: Who established Mughal rule in India?
nindian-history-4-12.x: Babur established Mughal rule after defeating Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat in 1526; Sher Shah Suri founded the Sur dynasty.

nindian-history-19-13.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat.
2. Babur defeated Rana Sanga in the Battle of Khanwa.
3. Babur assumed the title of Ghazi after the Battle of Khanwa.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-19-13.x: All three are correct: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi at First Panipat, then Rana Sanga at Khanwa, after which he took the title Ghazi.
